name: gptadmin
description: Connects the agent to your own OAuth-protected GPTAdmin Hub for server administration, child-MCP installation, and profile-scoped workflows. Ships a placeholder Hub URL that you replace with your own before first use.
author: GPTAdmin contributors
exampleQueries: Set up GPTAdmin — I need to point the plugin at my own Hub.
Show my GPTAdmin machines and which ones are online.
Run uptime on one of my machines through GPTAdmin.
Add a new machine: install ShellMCP and get it approved.
